capture.source_sha256_command: shasum -a 256; verified against the exported snapshot, working files, and committed Git blobs before committing evidence
capture.behavior: Each after state retains annual selection and allows a real pointer retry; both checkout attempts use fixture_pro_year. Before PlansSheet dismisses; SettingsPage/storefront show no popup warning. Keyboard activation used for initial launch in both versions so the uncorrected baseline dialog layout does not block the comparison.
